filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint.
Currently supported filters are:

+ id: Returns only the action having the id or all actions except those having the id(s). (operations: list_actions, list_capabilities)

sortBy.description:
JSON specifying sort criteria.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/) endpoint. Currently supported sorts are:

+ *No sort supported yet* (operations: list_actions, list_capabilities)

id.description: action id which is the name of the action (operations: get_action, get_capabilities)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
